reference_findings.diagnosis: Suspected acute stent thrombosis causing acute coronary syndrome; immediate specialist escalation is required in the simulation.
reference_findings.risk_assessment: Severe / emergency; qualitative simulation label only, not a validated score.

investigation_reports.ecg: New ST elevation in leads matching the previously treated territory in the synthetic tracing.
investigation_reports.laboratory_panel: Initial hs-cTn elevated with rising repeat; CBC and renal function obtained; platelet count and bleeding history require review.
investigation_reports.echocardiography: New regional wall-motion abnormality in the stented territory; LVEF estimated 40% in the synthetic report.
investigation_reports.coronary_or_other_imaging: Reference angiography: thrombotic occlusion within recently placed proximal RCA stent, TIMI 0 flow. Other vessels show moderate non-culprit disease. This is a fictional emergency finding.
investigation_reports.initial_vitals: HR 104 bpm; BP 104/68 mmHg; RR 22/min; SpO2 94%; anxious and diaphoretic.

medication_reconciliation: Discharge antiplatelet regimen listed but adherence and interruptions are unknown; reconcile urgently
allergy_history: Possible previous medication-related rash, culprit unclear; verify

pathway_review.reason: Compatible symptoms and ECG after recent PCI are time-critical.

pathway_review.label: Review antiplatelet adherence and interactions in parallel without delaying escalation
pathway_review.reason: Important for cause analysis but must not delay emergency care.

pathway_review.label: Book routine outpatient follow-up only
pathway_review.reason: Dangerous under-triage of possible acute coronary occlusion.

reference_findings.safety_review: Emergency escalation, bleeding risk, platelet count, antithrombotic medication history, adherence/interaction review, allergy status and post-event monitoring. No drug dosing in this simulator.
reference_findings.simulated_clinical_course: Reference branch: emergency team activation and simulated restoration of flow; debrief examines adherence uncertainty, event timeline and recurrence prevention review.
learning_objectives: Treat medication reconciliation as critical but not a reason to delay escalation.
reference_findings.review_note: Synthetic scenario. Clinical values and pathway labels require qualified interventional cardiology review before deployment. Educational use only; not real-patient guidance.
